body.heading: About this sheet
paragraphs: Free SparkKindly Kids mazes printable: Find the Path 10.
A maze to solve from START to FINISH — trace the route with a finger first, then draw it with a pencil when you are sure.

body.heading: How to use it
paragraphs: Print the sheet. Finger first, pencil second: dead ends are not mistakes, they are the maze teaching you its secrets.

takeaway: Mazes grow planning, patience and the fine pencil control that handwriting needs.
materials: A pencil with an eraser for brave attempts
supervision: Resist solving it for them — ask "what happens if you go that way?" and let the dead ends teach.
safetyNotes: Print at 100% size (not "fit to page") so the sheet keeps its true size and the pictures stay the size they were drawn.
screenFreeExtension: Draw your own maze on the back of the sheet and challenge a grown-up to solve it.
